title: Cross-boundary readiness derivation for global containers
description: WHY: a portfolio container that cannot block on project work is a label, not a manager. WHAT: (1) allow global workspace dep add to accept a boreal URI as the blocker, creating a cross-project graph edge (sprint G3 fields) in the global store; (2) extend readiness derivation for global work so cross-project dependencies resolve through the rollup cache: the referenced items status comes from the target rollup (terminal statuses unblock, everything else blocks, unknown-because-stale blocks with a distinct stale reason); (3) recomputation triggers when the aggregator refreshes a rollup whose project is referenced by any global edge - the daemon sweep from sprint G4 calls a global recompute hook; (4) emit the existing work.blocked.open-dependency enforcement gap with the qualified reference in data so directives name the blocking project item. Fail-soft rules: unlinked or missing projects make dependents blocked with reason unresolved, never crash recompute.
acceptanceCriteria: A global container blocked on a project item unblocks after that item closes and the rollup refreshes, covered by a two-workspace end-to-end test
Stale and unresolved references block with distinct typed reasons visible in work show
